name: find-skill-skillhub
description: 在 SkillHub 平台查找/搜索 Skill 技能。基于 skills 列表接口，支持关键词分词搜索、一级标签（一级分类）筛选、以及二者组合检索。当用户说『找个 xxx 技能』『有没有处理 PDF 的 skill』『SkillHub 上搜一下 xxx』『按分类看技能』『办公效率类有哪些技能』『推荐一个做数据分析的 skill』『这个需求有现成技能吗』等需要在 SkillHub 上发现/检索/推荐 Skill 的场景时使用本技能。

name: art-bible
description: 艺术圣经创作。引导式分章节视觉规范编写，产出视觉身份说明、色调系统、角色/环境/UI美术方向、资产标准和风格禁令。门控技能——所有资产生产前必须先通过此技能。

name: asset-audit
description: 审计游戏资产的命名规范、文件大小预算、格式标准和管线合规性。识别孤悬资产、缺失引用和标准违规。只读诊断工具。

name: asset-spec
description: 从 GDD/关卡文档/角色档案生成每项资产的视觉规格和 AI 生成提示词。产出结构化规格文件并更新主资产清单。

name: team-audio
description: 音频设计编排。从音频方向到设计文档的完整管线——声音身份定义、音效规格、技术实现方案。

name: ux-design
description: 引导式分章节 UX 规范编写。为屏幕/流程/HUD 产出交互设计规范，包含布局、交互映射、状态变体、可访问性和验收标准。

name: ux-review
description: 验证 UX 规范的完整性、可访问合规性、GDD 对齐和实施就绪度。产出 APPROVED / NEEDS REVISION / MAJOR REVISION NEEDED 评定。只读诊断工具。

name: context-engineering
description: Optimizes agent context setup. Use when starting a new session, when agent output quality degrades, when switching between tasks, or when you need to configure rules files and context for a project.

name: documentation-and-adrs
description: Records decisions and documentation. Use when making architectural decisions, changing public APIs, shipping features, or when you need to record context that future engineers and agents will need to understand the codebase.

name: doubt-driven-development
description: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production, security-sensitive logic, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later.

name: incremental-implementation
description: Delivers changes incrementally. Use when implementing any feature or change that touches more than one file. Use when you're about to write a large amount of code at once, or when a task feels too big to land in one step.

name: planning-and-task-breakdown
description: Breaks work into ordered tasks. Use when you have a spec or clear requirements and need to break work into implementable tasks. Use when a task feels too large to start, when you need to estimate scope, or when parallel work is possible.

name: security-and-hardening
description: Hardens code against vulnerabilities. Use when handling user input, authentication, data storage, or external integrations. Use when building any feature that accepts untrusted data, manages user sessions, or interacts with third-party services.

name: spec-driven-development
description: Creates specs before coding. Use when starting a new project, feature, or significant change and no specification exists yet. Use when requirements are unclear, ambiguous, or only exist as a vague idea.

name: balance-check
description: Find balance outliers, broken progressions, degenerate strategies, economy imbalances in formulas and data. 'Check game balance'.

name: bug-triage
description: Read all open bugs in production/qa/bugs/, re-evaluate priority vs. severity, assign to sprints, surface systemic trends, and produce a triage report. Run at sprint start or when the bug count grows enough to need re-prioritization.

name: changelog
description: Auto-generates a changelog from git commits, sprint data, and design documents. Produces both internal and player-facing versions.

name: code-review
description: 代码审查 — 对指定文件执行架构和代码质量审查。检查编码标准、架构模式、SOLID原则、可测试性和性能。

name: day-one-patch
description: Prepare a day-one patch for a game launch. Scopes, prioritises, implements, and QA-gates a focused patch addressing known issues discovered after gold master but before or immediately after public launch. Treats the patch as a mini-sprint with its own QA gate and rollback plan.

name: delivery-workflow
description: Structured AI delivery: mission lifecycle, evidence-backed QA, repo truth, release gates. Use for scoped build/review/approve workflows.

name: dev-story
description: Read a story file and implement it. Loads the full context (story, GDD requirement, ADR guidelines, control manifest), routes to the right programmer agent for the system and engine, implements the code and test, and confirms each acceptance criterion. The core implementation skill — run after /story-readiness, before /code-review and /story-done.

name: git-essentials
description: Essential Git commands and workflows for version control, branching, and collaboration.

name: git-helper
description: Common git operations as a skill (status, pull, push, branch, log)

name: github
description: Interact with GitHub using the `gh` CLI. Use `gh issue`, `gh pr`, `gh run`, and `gh api` for issues, PRs, CI runs, and advanced queries.

name: godot-coding-patterns
description: Godot/GDScript 编码模式库，从 awesome-godot 精选项目提取的代码实现模式和最佳实践。涵盖行为树、状态机、事件系统、资源管理、场景管理等。

name: hotfix
description: Emergency fix workflow that bypasses normal sprint processes with a full audit trail. Creates hotfix branch, tracks approvals, and ensures the fix is backported correctly.

name: impl-design
description: 按设计需求输出代码实现 — 读取设计规格文档，理解需求，输出可运行的代码并验证每个验收标准。

name: launch-checklist
description: Complete launch readiness validation covering every department: code, content, store, marketing, community, infrastructure, legal, and go/no-go sign-offs.

name: perf-profile
description: Structured performance profiling workflow. Identifies bottlenecks, measures against budgets, and generates optimization recommendations with priority rankings.

name: playtest-report
description: Structured playtest report template, or turn existing playtest notes into structured feedback.

name: qa-plan
description: QA test plan for a sprint — classifies stories by Logic/Integration/Visual/UI, covers automated tests, manual cases, smoke scope.

name: regression-suite
description: Map test coverage to GDD critical paths, identify fixed bugs without regression tests, flag coverage drift from new features, and maintain tests/regression-suite.md. Run after implementing a bug fix or before a release gate.

name: security-audit
description: Audit the game for security vulnerabilities: save tampering, cheat vectors, network exploits, data exposure, and input validation gaps. Produces a prioritised security report with remediation guidance. Run before any public release or multiplayer launch.

name: setup-engine
description: Configure the project's game engine and version. Pins the engine in AGENTS.md, detects knowledge gaps, and populates engine reference docs via WebSearch when the version is beyond the LLM's training data.

name: smoke-check
description: Run the critical path smoke test gate before QA hand-off. Executes the automated test suite, verifies core functionality, and produces a PASS/FAIL report. Run after a sprint's stories are implemented and before manual QA begins. A failed smoke check means the build is not ready for QA.

name: soak-test
description: Generate a soak test protocol for extended play sessions. Defines what to observe, measure, and log during long play sessions to surface slow leaks, fatigue effects, and edge cases that only appear after sustained play. Primarily used in Polish and Release phases.

name: sprint-status
description: Fast sprint status check. Reads the current sprint plan, scans story files for status, and produces a concise progress snapshot with burndown assessment and emerging risks. Run at any time during a sprint for quick situational awareness. Use when user asks 'how is the sprint going', 'sprint update', 'show sprint progress'.

name: story-done
description: End-of-story completion review. Reads the story file, verifies each acceptance criterion against the implementation, checks for GDD/ADR deviations, prompts code review, updates story status to Complete, and surfaces the next ready story from the sprint.

name: tech-debt
description: Track, categorize, and prioritize technical debt across the codebase. Scans for debt indicators, maintains a debt register, and recommends repayment scheduling.

name: test-evidence-review
description: Quality review of test files and manual evidence documents. Goes beyond existence checks — evaluates assertion coverage, edge case handling, naming conventions, and evidence completeness. Produces ADEQUATE/INCOMPLETE/MISSING verdict per story. Run before QA sign-off or on demand.

name: test-flakiness
description: Detect non-deterministic (flaky) tests by reading CI run logs or test result history. Aggregates pass rates per test, identifies intermittent failures, recommends quarantine or fix, and maintains a flaky test registry. Best run during Polish phase or after multiple CI runs.

name: test-helpers
description: Generate engine-specific test helper libraries for the project's test suite. Reads existing test patterns and produces tests/helpers/ with assertion utilities, factory functions, and mock objects tailored to the project's systems. Reduces boilerplate in new test files.

name: test-setup
description: Scaffold the test framework and CI/CD pipeline for the project's engine. Creates the tests/ directory structure, engine-specific test runner configuration, and GitHub Actions workflow. Run once during Technical Setup phase before the first sprint begins.

name: vertical-slice
description: Pre-Production validation — build a production-quality end-to-end build to confirm the full game loop is achievable before committing to Production. Run after GDDs, architecture, and UX specs are complete. Produces a PROCEED/PIVOT/KILL verdict that gates the Pre-Production → Production transition.

name: architecture-review
description: Traceability matrix mapping GDD requirements to ADRs. Finds gaps, cross-ADR conflicts, engine compatibility. PASS/CONCERNS/NOT ASSESSED/FAIL.

name: consistency-check
description: Scan GDDs against the entity registry for cross-document conflicts. Grep-first approach targets conflicting sections, different stats.

name: design-review
description: Reviews one design document for completeness, internal consistency, implementability, and design standards. Before handing to programmers.

name: game-studio-architecture-decision
description: 创建架构决策记录(ADR)，记录重大技术决策、上下文、备选方案和后果。

name: game-studio-architecture-review
description: Validates completeness and consistency of the project architecture against all GDDs. Builds a traceability matrix mapping every GDD technical requirement to ADRs, identifies coverage gaps, detects cross-ADR conflicts, verifies engine compatibility consistency across all decisions, and produces a PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL verdict. The architecture equivalent of /design-review.

name: game-studio-balance-check
description: 分析游戏平衡数据、公式和配置，识别异常值、断裂进度、退化策略和经济失衡。

name: game-studio-brainstorm
description: 引导式游戏概念构思 — 从零到结构化游戏概念文档。使用专业工作室构思技术和玩家心理学框架。

name: game-studio-bug-report
description: 从描述创建结构化Bug报告，或分析代码识别潜在Bug。

name: game-studio-create-architecture
description: Guided, section-by-section authoring of the master architecture document for the game. Reads all GDDs, the systems index, existing ADRs, and the engine reference library to produce a complete architecture blueprint before any code is written. Engine-version-aware: flags knowledge gaps and validates decisions against the pinned engine version.

name: game-studio-create-epics
description: 将已批准的GDD和架构转化为史诗 — 每个架构模块一个史诗。定义范围、治理ADR、引擎风险。

name: game-studio-create-stories
description: 将Epic分解为可实施的用户故事。每个故事有明确的验收标准、技术上下文和测试要求。

name: game-studio-design-review
description: 审查游戏设计文档的完整性、内部一致性、可实施性和项目设计标准遵循。

name: game-studio-design-system
description: 引导式、逐节GDD编写。从现有文档收集上下文，协作走完每个必要章节，交叉引用依赖，增量写入文件。

name: game-studio-help
description: 游戏工作室帮助 — 列出所有可用的工作流技能和当前项目状态。

name: game-studio-localize
description: Full localization pipeline: scan for hardcoded strings, extract and manage string tables, validate translations, generate translator briefings, run cultural/sensitivity review, manage VO localization, test RTL/platform requirements, enforce string freeze, and report coverage.

name: game-studio-map-systems
description: Decompose a game concept into individual systems, map dependencies, prioritize design order, and create the systems index.

name: game-studio-project-stage-detect
description: Automatically analyze project state, detect stage, identify gaps, and recommend next steps based on existing artifacts. Use when user asks 'where are we in development', 'what stage are we in', 'full project audit'.

name: game-studio-prototype
description: 概念原型 — 在写GDD前验证核心想法是否值得深入设计。路由到HTML/引擎/纸上路径。产出一次性构建和PROCEED/PIVOT/KILL判决。

name: game-studio-qa-plan
description: 为Sprint或功能生成QA测试计划。读取GDD和故事文件，按测试类型分类，产出结构化测试计划。

name: game-studio-quick-design
description: Lightweight design spec for small changes — tuning adjustments, minor mechanics, balance tweaks. Skips full GDD authoring when a system GDD already exists or the change is too small to warrant one. Produces a Quick Design Spec that embeds directly into story files.

name: game-studio-release-checklist
description: 生成全面的预发布验证清单，覆盖构建验证、认证要求、商店元数据和启动就绪。

name: game-studio-review-all-gdds
description: Holistic cross-GDD consistency and game design review. Reads all system GDDs simultaneously and checks for contradictions between them, stale references, ownership conflicts, formula incompatibilities, and game design theory violations (dominant strategies, economic imbalance, cognitive overload, pillar drift). Run after all MVP GDDs are written, before architecture begins.

name: game-studio-scope-check
description: 分析功能或Sprint的范围膨胀，比较当前范围与原始计划。标记增加项、量化膨胀、推荐裁剪。

name: game-studio-sprint-plan
description: 生成新的Sprint计划或更新现有计划。从生产文档和设计积压中提取上下文。

name: game-studio-start
description: 首次启动引导 — 询问项目状态，引导到正确工作流。不做假设。

name: game-studio-team-combat
description: Orchestrate the combat team: coordinates game-designer, gameplay-programmer, ai-programmer, technical-artist, sound-designer, and qa-tester to design, implement, and validate a combat feature end-to-end.

name: game-studio-team-level
description: Orchestrate level design team: level-designer + narrative-director + world-builder + art-director + systems-designer + qa-tester for complete area/level creation.

name: game-studio-team-live-ops
description: Orchestrate the live-ops team for post-launch content planning: coordinates live-ops-designer, economy-designer, analytics-engineer, community-manager, writer, and narrative-director to design and plan a season, event, or live content update.

name: Email Management
description: Triage inbox email, draft clear replies, and manage follow-ups with priority routing, commitment tracking, and reusable templates.

name: harness-anything-mac
description: 跨平台 Office + 设计 + 学术全栈 AI 操控 CLI。通过 JSON 文档模型 + COM 自动化创建和编辑 Word/Excel/PPT 文档。

name: tencent-docs
description: 腾讯文档，提供完整的腾讯文档操作能力。当用户需要操作腾讯文档时使用此skill，包括：(1) 创建各类在线文档（智能文档、Word、Excel、幻灯片、思维导图、流程图）(2) 查询、搜索文档空间与文件 (3) 管理空间节点、文件夹结构 (4) 读取文档内容 (5) 编辑操作智能表 （6）编辑操作智能文档。

name: anysearch
description: Real-time search engine supporting web search, vertical domain search, parallel batch search, and URL content extraction.

name: awesome-novel
description: 和 AI 协作写小说的工作流系统。流程：一次设定→规划卷纲→逐章写作循环（章纲→提示词→验收→正文→验收→评审→归档→下一章）。适用场景：从零写新小说、导入已有小说。

name: novel-archive
description: 章节归档与状态更新。正文验收通过后归档——去 draft 标记、更新角色状态/情绪弧线/钩子追踪、滑动窗口审视、卷边界检测。触发："归档""存档""这章完成了"。

name: novel-body-verify
description: 正文验收——检查草稿是否符合 10 维质量标准。触发：主流程检测到 draft + archives 有草稿时自动分发。

name: chapter-reference
description: 获取参考 skill

name: novel-chapter
description: 章纲设定——从卷纲拆出每章内容规划。触发："规划章节""章纲""这章写什么""拆章节"。章纲完成后自动路由到提示词生成。

name: detect-loop
description: detect-loop skill — 外部检测校准闭环（作者触发，可选）

name: memory-recording
description: 写作记忆记录 skill

name: novel-migrate
description: 旧版项目迁移。Step 1 检测到 story.yaml 或 skill_version 过低时分发至此。将 2.x 格式的 YAML 设定→Markdown，挪入 old/ 回滚保留。仅已归档章节迁移，在制章节跳过。

name: novel-dispatch
description: novel-agent 调度 SOP

name: novel-outline
description: 主线拆纲+卷纲规划。设定完成后规划故事结构：先拆主线（总主线→拆几卷→每卷冲突），再逐卷展开（卷方向→卷纲讨论）。触发："规划章节""分卷""故事线""卷纲""规划卷"。

name: prompt-audit
description: Prompt 审计 SOP

name: novel-prompt
description: 章提示词生成——从章纲生产 prompt.md。触发：章纲确认后自动分发或手动"生成本章提示词"。完成后回到主流程。

name: novel-prompt-verify
description: 提示词验收——检查生成的 prompt.md 是否完整、可执行。触发：主流程检测到 outline + prompt 文件存在时自动分发。

name: novel-proofread
description: 文字校对+安全审查+故事层审校+跨章一致性——一次精读完成编校全流程。触发：正文草稿生成完成（status=draft）→ 执行本 skill → 再到 body-verify。

name: novel-review
description: 章节深度评审——对已完成正文进行 10 维 60+ 细项诊断。可随时触发，不阻断流程。逐条对照章纲/卷纲/世界设定/角色设定/写作风格/前文/钩子/作者意图/中期聚焦/逻辑一致性。触发："评审""评价""review""检查这章""这章写得怎么样"。

name: roleplay-sandbox
description: **什么时候用：** 作者主动要求剧情推演，或新章编写过程中卡剧情——有核心故事但不知道怎么展开成具体剧情。推演记录给你角色行为素材，帮你写出章纲。

name: novel-setup
description: 小说项目初始化与设定。当项目尚未创建、world-setting.md 为空、或用户说"创建项目""讨论设定""设计角色""世界观""写作风格""题材""导入小说"时必须使用。即使只说"帮我开始写小说"也要先加载本技能完成设定。

description: short-analyze skill — 短篇拆文（独立工具）

name: short-audit
description: short-audit SOP — 契约独立审计

name: short-craft-prompt
description: short-craft-prompt SOP — 写作契约组装

name: short-plan
description: short-plan SOP — 定情绪与排纲

name: short-scan
description: short-scan skill — 短篇扫榜（独立工具）

name: short-verify
description: short-verify SOP — 定稿兑现度核对

name: short-write
description: short-write SOP — 正文分批写作

description: style-distill skill — 三阶段 13 模板 LLM 蒸馏（style-distill-order）

description: updater-archive-sop

description: updater 回滚 skill — 撤销本章归档追加

description: 正文生成——根据提示词写完整章正文。触发：提示词验收通过后自动分发，或手动"写正文""写这章"。完成后回到主流程。

name: python-web-scraper
description: Python 网页爬虫工具集，支持 requests+BeautifulSoup 静态抓取、httpx 异步爬取、API 接口采集、JSON/CSV/Excel 数据导出。提供标准化脚本模板，开箱即用。

name: self-improving-agent
description: A universal self-improving agent that learns from ALL skill experiences. Uses multi-memory architecture (semantic + episodic + working) to continuously evolve the codebase. Auto-triggers on skill completion/error with hooks-based self-correction.

name: find-skill-skillhub
description: 在 SkillHub 平台查找/搜索 Skill 技能。基于 skills 列表接口，支持关键词分词搜索、一级标签（一级分类）筛选、以及二者组合检索。当用户说『找个 xxx 技能』『有没有处理 PDF 的 skill』『SkillHub 上搜一下 xxx』『按分类看技能』『办公效率类有哪些技能』『推荐一个做数据分析的 skill』『这个需求有现成技能吗』等需要在 SkillHub 上发现/检索/推荐 Skill 的场景时使用本技能。

name: web-tools-guide
description: MANDATORY before calling web_search, web_fetch, browser, or opencli. Contains required error-handling procedures (web_search failure → must guide user to configure API), fallback chain (opencli CLI covers 70+ sites as structured fallback before browser), and site-specific login URLs. Without reading this skill, you WILL handle failures incorrectly and miss available tools. Trigger on: 搜索/上网/查资料/打开

description: Godot 类名冲突检查器。在 Godot 项目中创建自定义类时，避免与 Godot 内置类名发生命名冲突。

name: godot-clear-children
description: Godot正确清除子节点的方法。当用户需要了解如何正确清除子节点时使用。

name: godot-console
description: 提供Godot引擎控制台命令行工具的调用能力，支持运行Godot命令、执行脚本、导出项目等操作，适用于游戏开发和自动化任务。

name: godot-gdscript-grammar
description: Godot GDScript语法详解。当用户需要GDScript语法相关信息时使用。

name: godot-global-variables
description: Godot全局变量使用指南。当用户需要全局变量和Autoload相关信息时使用。

name: godot-knowledge
description: 提供 Godot GDScript 编程语言和 TSCN 场景文件格式的完整知识库，适用于游戏开发、UI 设计和场景构建。

name: godot-packedscene
description: Godot PackedScene使用指南。当用户需要场景加载和池化相关信息时使用。

name: godot-scene-skill
description: Godot UI与场景开发指南。当用户需要UI和场景开发相关信息时使用。

name: godot-serialization-pattern

name: novel-proofread

name: novel-review
description: 章节深度评审——对已完成正文进行 10 维 60+ 细项诊断。可随时触发，不阻断流程。逐条对照章纲/卷纲/世界设定/角色设定/写作风格/前文/钩子/作者意图/中期聚焦/逻辑一致性。触发："评审""评价""review""检查这章""这章写得怎么样"。

name: roleplay-sandbox
description: **什么时候用：** 作者主动要求剧情推演，或新章编写过程中卡剧情——有核心故事但不知道怎么展开成具体剧情。推演记录给你角色行为素材，帮你写出章纲。

name: novel-setup

name: game-dev-lessons
description: 引擎无关的游戏开发通用原则与编码前检查清单。

name: game-studio-architecture-decision
description: 创建架构决策记录(ADR)，记录重大技术决策、上下文、备选方案和后果。

name: game-studio-architecture-review
description: Validates completeness and consistency of the project architecture against all GDDs. Builds a traceability matrix mapping every GDD technical requirement to ADRs, identifies coverage gaps, detects cross-ADR conflicts, verifies engine compatibility consistency across all decisions, and produces a PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL verdict. The architecture equivalent of /design-review.

name: game-studio-balance-check
description: 分析游戏平衡数据、公式和配置，识别异常值、断裂进度、退化策略和经济失衡。

name: game-studio-brainstorm
description: 引导式游戏概念构思 — 从零到结构化游戏概念文档。使用专业工作室构思技术和玩家心理学框架。

name: game-studio-bug-report
description: 从描述创建结构化Bug报告，或分析代码识别潜在Bug。

name: game-studio-create-architecture
description: Guided, section-by-section authoring of the master architecture document for the game. Reads all GDDs, the systems index, existing ADRs, and the engine reference library to produce a complete architecture blueprint before any code is written. Engine-version-aware: flags knowledge gaps and validates decisions against the pinned engine version.

name: game-studio-create-epics
description: 将已批准的GDD和架构转化为史诗 — 每个架构模块一个史诗。定义范围、治理ADR、引擎风险。

name: game-studio-create-stories
description: 将Epic分解为可实施的用户故事。每个故事有明确的验收标准、技术上下文和测试要求。

name: game-studio-design-review
description: 审查游戏设计文档的完整性、内部一致性、可实施性和项目设计标准遵循。

name: game-studio-design-system
description: 引导式、逐节GDD编写。从现有文档收集上下文，协作走完每个必要章节，交叉引用依赖，增量写入文件。

name: game-studio-help
description: 游戏工作室帮助 — 列出所有可用的工作流技能和当前项目状态。

name: game-studio-localize
description: Full localization pipeline: scan for hardcoded strings, extract and manage string tables, validate translations, generate translator briefings, run cultural/sensitivity review, manage VO localization, test RTL/platform requirements, enforce string freeze, and report coverage.

name: game-studio-map-systems
description: Decompose a game concept into individual systems, map dependencies, prioritize design order, and create the systems index.

name: game-studio-project-stage-detect
description: Automatically analyze project state, detect stage, identify gaps, and recommend next steps based on existing artifacts. Use when user asks 'where are we in development', 'what stage are we in', 'full project audit'.

name: game-studio-prototype
description: 概念原型 — 在写GDD前验证核心想法是否值得深入设计。路由到HTML/引擎/纸上路径。产出一次性构建和PROCEED/PIVOT/KILL判决。

name: game-studio-qa-plan
description: 为Sprint或功能生成QA测试计划。读取GDD和故事文件，按测试类型分类，产出结构化测试计划。

name: game-studio-quick-design
description: Lightweight design spec for small changes — tuning adjustments, minor mechanics, balance tweaks. Skips full GDD authoring when a system GDD already exists or the change is too small to warrant one. Produces a Quick Design Spec that embeds directly into story files.

name: game-studio-release-checklist
description: 生成全面的预发布验证清单，覆盖构建验证、认证要求、商店元数据和启动就绪。

name: game-studio-review-all-gdds
description: Holistic cross-GDD consistency and game design review. Reads all system GDDs simultaneously and checks for contradictions between them, stale references, ownership conflicts, formula incompatibilities, and game design theory violations (dominant strategies, economic imbalance, cognitive overload, pillar drift). Run after all MVP GDDs are written, before architecture begins.

name: game-studio-scope-check
description: 分析功能或Sprint的范围膨胀，比较当前范围与原始计划。标记增加项、量化膨胀、推荐裁剪。

name: game-studio-sprint-plan
description: 生成新的Sprint计划或更新现有计划。从生产文档和设计积压中提取上下文。

name: game-studio-start
description: 首次启动引导 — 询问项目状态，引导到正确工作流。不做假设。

name: game-studio-team-combat
description: Orchestrate the combat team: coordinates game-designer, gameplay-programmer, ai-programmer, technical-artist, sound-designer, and qa-tester to design, implement, and validate a combat feature end-to-end.

name: game-studio-team-level
description: Orchestrate level design team: level-designer + narrative-director + world-builder + art-director + systems-designer + qa-tester for complete area/level creation.

name: game-studio-team-live-ops
description: Orchestrate the live-ops team for post-launch content planning: coordinates live-ops-designer, economy-designer, analytics-engineer, community-manager, writer, and narrative-director to design and plan a season, event, or live content update.
